data.name: Cli_Help
data.value:
XamlNexus - Windows desktop prototype scaffolding
Quick start: xamlnexus new MyApp cd MyApp xamlnexus run Stop with Ctrl+C before editing or running again. Edit MyApp.MainPanel/MainPage.xaml and ViewModels/MainViewModel.cs. xamlnexus page add Workspace xamlnexus run After stopping: xamlnexus add sqlite, then xamlnexus run.
Usage: xamlnexus Start interactive mode xamlnexus new <name> [options] Create a project xamlnexus page add <name> [--project <directory>] [--no-navigation] [--dry-run] [--json] Add a page; --no-navigation skips navigation registration. xamlnexus run [path] [--project <directory>] [--no-build] [--dry-run] [--json] Build and run Debug/x64 unpackaged; Ctrl+C stops this run. --no-build uses existing output; no watch or hot reload. xamlnexus list [path] [--json] List project capabilities xamlnexus validate [path] [--json] Validate the manifest and managed files xamlnexus doctor [path] [--json] Diagnose environment and project health xamlnexus upgrade [path] [options] Upgrade scaffold-managed infrastructure xamlnexus recipes [--json] List built-in Recipes xamlnexus add <recipe[,recipe...]> [options] Install Recipes transactionally xamlnexus remove <recipe> [options] Remove a Recipe transactionally xamlnexus update <recipe> [options] Update a Recipe transactionally xamlnexus --help Show help (aliases: help, -h, -?) xamlnexus --version Show version
New options: -n, --name <name> Project name (or use the positional name) -p, --preset <preset> winui (default) or hybrid -o, --output <directory> Parent output directory (default: current directory) --profile <standard|basic> Starting capability profile (default: standard) basic omits the full settings panel; core services remain. --features <ids> Install comma-separated Recipes during creation -l, --language <language> Generated application language: zh-CN (default) or en-US -f, --solution-format <format> sln (default) or slnx
Project command options: -p, --project <path> Project directory or xamlnexus.json path --dry-run Validate and show changes without writing files --json Emit machine-readable query or change output --resolve-from <directory> Apply manually resolved upgrade .merge files --conflict-output <directory> Export upgrade merge conflicts (writes files)
Examples: xamlnexus new MyApp xamlnexus new MinimalApp --profile basic xamlnexus new DataApp --profile basic --features settings,sqlite xamlnexus run --project MyApp xamlnexus page add Workspace --project MyApp --dry-run xamlnexus new MyApp --preset hybrid --output D:\Projects --language en-US xamlnexus list D:\Projects\MyApp xamlnexus validate --project D:\Projects\MyApp --json xamlnexus doctor --project D:\Projects\MyApp --json xamlnexus upgrade --project D:\Projects\MyApp --dry-run --json xamlnexus upgrade --project D:\Projects\MyApp --conflict-output .\upgrade-conflicts xamlnexus recipes xamlnexus add editorconfig --project D:\Projects\MyApp --dry-run xamlnexus remove editorconfig --project D:\Projects\MyApp xamlnexus update sqlite --project D:\Projects\MyApp
Recipes: settings, sqlite, tray, updater, editorconfig. standard includes settings; hybrid includes tray and updater. updater depends on settings. Already installed Recipes are skipped. Guide: https://github.com/PaperHammer/XamlNexus/blob/main/docs/user-guide/quickstart.md
Tip: Use "xn" as an alias in the current terminal session: CMD: doskey xn=xamlnexus $* PowerShell: Set-Alias xn xamlnexus Then run: xn -h The alias expires when the session ends.
